browser_evidence_assessment.limits: Browser evidence verifies rendering, controls and tested invariants; this independent semantic review remains bounded to changed assistant product meaning and integration handoffs, and does not grant user approval.

coverage.scope_note: Independent product meaning review covers changed assistant and unified-entry/host handoffs. Browser evidence observes all manifest scenes. Unchanged host modules and historical source snapshots are not re-approved by this report.

findings.element: 附件存在时的生成文件行及查看生成文件操作
findings.rule: 文件存在事实必须属于原会话；附加材料不等于已经生成输出。
findings.observed: 新建会话只选择附件、尚未发送时，files 分支仍显示生成文件资料汇总.md；actionEnabled(view) 因 getAttachment 为真允许打开固定输出。无附件空会话已修，但有附件无生成的路径未修。
findings.recommendation: 附件存在与生成文件存在分开判断；仅 saved fixture 或已产生输出记录的会话允许生成文件行/打开动作。
evidence: browser.json transition coverage does not include this existence invariant
findings.resolution: getAttachment and generated-file availability are separate. Only saved fixture permits view; new conversation with only an attachment omits the generated-file row and cannot open generated output. Actual selected text remains accessible through attachment.
resolution_evidence: invariants.json:attachment alone creates no generated file

findings.element: 侧栏数据源导航后的连接状态
findings.rule: 普通导航不得将失败/拒绝写成成功；缓存和页面选择不能代替授权。
findings.observed: sourcefailed/sourcedenied 的 sources 导航指向 sources；Sources 渲染在非失败/拒绝/未连接/连接中 key 上固定为已连接；runtime 无 source connection 状态。因此选择同一项目资料目录即可显示已连接。
findings.recommendation: 与技能状态同样，按 scope+source 保留当前连接状态；评审注入修改初态，导航保持，连接动作仅改 connecting。
findings.resolution: sourceStatus persists by scope. Review-injected source fixtures initialize status; actual sources navigation preserves failure/denial; connect/cancel update connecting/disconnected rather than success.
resolution_evidence: invariants.json:sourcefailed list navigation retains connection failure
invariants.json:sourcedenied list navigation retains connection failure

reviews.rationale: PC-F04 和 PC-N04 要求消息、草稿、问题和文件绑定原会话；断网恢复不重发。
reviews.observed: scope+conversation 存储、新建唯一 ID、原会话恢复、canRead/canSend 与 availability 恢复链已核实；消息顺序已调整；权限拒绝含系统设置路径。

reviews.rationale: 授权、本人启用、本机准备相互独立；企业不继承个人圈子；失败不可由导航恢复。
reviews.observed: Skill persistent state and guarded operations preserve authorization, enabled preference, device/version and built-in preference across navigation/preparation. Enterprise fallback removed; empty state lists match content. Source connection status now persists through real navigation, verified for failure/denial in both scopes.

reviews.rationale: 合法原对话访问与真实文件选择；不得伪造恢复或生成文件。
reviews.observed: Missing files require actual selection before recovery; selected names and text preview work. Inaccessible sessions cannot read prior content. Empty new sessions have no fixture files, and selecting an attachment does not invent a generated file. Final two file predicates were independently executed.

reviews.rationale: 主动单次查询、到账只解对应阻断、不重发，Owner/成员和预算/积分分别处理。
reviews.observed: 个人 stream 返回保持中断状态；成员预算、Owner 查询、预算与积分并存阻断、权限阻断及普通发送已核实；没有自动充值查询或一键续写。

observations.detail: Changed assistant behavior is supported by current Spec PC-F04/07/08/10, PC-N03/04, C-R02/03/04/06 and D-PC-03/08/09. Baseline sources support component provenance, not current whole-shell fidelity.

Previously identified violations resolved in final source and current browser invariants. Skill, session, file, source and fee recovery states retain required distinctions. No unresolved concrete issue found in reviewed changed scope.

Failures are declared review states; product controls are actual navigation, input, preference, permission and recovery actions. No simulation/state-selection product control found in changed assistant source.

product_approval: Not granted; behavior/layout remains subject to user review. Browser/semantic checks do not record confirmation.

independent_runtime_probes.method: Imported final runtime with mocked parent message channel; executed real reset/new/setAttachment/files actions and inspected access predicates/content.
Imported final runtime; for both scopes injected sourcefailed/sourcedenied, executed real sources navigation, inspected getSourceStatus.

final_verdict: Passed for the recorded changed-assistant and unified-entry integration review scope. All reported findings resolved. This is quality evidence, not implementation acceptance or user approval.
